description: Check a domain's email authentication from public DNS — SPF (present, single, within 10 lookups, how it ends), DMARC (policy, pct, reporting), a DKIM selector, BIMI, the mail and DNS providers, DNSSEC and CAA — each pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. DNS only: the site is never visited. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

domain.description: The domain to look up (example.com), or any URL on it.

name: check_email_dns

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Check email DNS (SPF, DMARC, DKIM)
